reports.summary_en: User reports that their Bosch PSB 18 LI-2 drill (purchased April 2017) stopped starting after 8 years. The drill shows flashing green and white LEDs (3 flashes), indicating a system error. The issue persists across two fully charged batteries, suggesting a hardware failure in the drill’s internal electronics.
